canada.title: First Nations have ‘every right’ to be skeptical of major projects office: Farrell
canada.summary: OTTAWA - The head of the federal government's major projects office says First Nations have every right to be skeptical of her office's intentions.

canada.title: Alberta bill would stop provincial entities from considering diversity, equity and inclusion in hiring
canada.summary: The first bill in the Alberta Legislature's fall sitting seeks to stop the provincial government and other public entities from considering diversity, equity and inclusion in hiring decisions, and to give victims recourse when someone shares intimate content of them without their consent.

canada.title: Olympic Stadium awards $254K emergency waterproofing contract
canada.summary: The $254,000 contract was awarded to Aquabloc to waterproof 35 concrete structures on the outside of the stadium.

canada.title: Watchdog sounds alarm after N.L.'s largest jail runs out of toothbrushes
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador's citizens' representative says his office got a flood of complaints last week stating inmates at Her Majesty's Penitentiary in St. John's were not being given toothbrushes.

canada.title: EverWind proposes binding agreement with N.S. on data centre rules
canada.summary: The company that wants to build $8-billion-worth of data centres in Point Tupper, N.S., says it’s offered to sign an agreement with the province to hold it to its promises.

canada.title: Carney is looking at changing the Indian Act. Here’s what you need to know
canada.summary: OTTAWA - It's one of the most important laws in Canada's history, it's widely loathed by the people it affects — and most Canadians know little about it.

canada.title: Saskatchewan throne speech paints province as strong and steady during global uncertainty
canada.summary: "The world is uncertain," said Lt.-Gov. Bernadette McIntyre, as she opened her speech on Tuesday. "Saskatchewan isn't."

canada.title: N.L. Liberals question timing, circumstance of Churchill Falls adviser's departure
canada.summary: The departure of lawyer Bernard Coffey as an advisor to government on the new Churchill River power agreement between utilities in Quebec and Newfoundland and Labrador has been a major topic in the Newfoundland and Labrador House of Assembly. Coffey has, so far, opted not to comment.

canada.title: 'It's food. It's art': Winnipeg college students working to craft new low-cal mocktails
canada.summary: Students at Red River Polytechnic in Winnipeg are working with a local beverage company to develop low-calorie mocktails and energy beverages they'll actually drink.

canada.title: Ex-Jet goalie Hellebuyck to make New Jersey Devils debut Tuesday against Dallas Stars
canada.summary: Connor Hellebuyck is set to make his debut for the New Jersey Devils when the goaltender starts at Dallas on Tuesday night.

canada.title: TransAqua plans to stop composting sewage at Moncton site
canada.summary: Wastewater utility TransAqua plans to stop operating a sewage composting facility that's been blamed for a pungent odour in Moncton's north end.

canada.title: Ford says he feels 'badly' for students caught up in his government's career college OSAP pause
canada.summary: On the first day back after a 147-day break from the Ontario legislature, provincial opposition parties spent much of question period calling for colleges and universities minister Nolan Quinn to be fired for his handling of the OSAP program.

canada.title: Yellowknife RCMP search for missing woman
canada.summary: Police say Chelsey Normandin, 35, was last seen on Oct. 20 and reported missing on Monday afternoon.

canada.title: RCMP investigating Alberta health procurement for possible fraud, money laundering
canada.summary: Mounties looking into an Alberta health care spending controversy are investigating potential fraud, breach of trust, and money laundering.

canada.title: Former Ontario cabinet minister who resigned over expenses scandal defends promotion
canada.summary: A former member of Ontario Premier Doug Ford's cabinet who resigned his post over an expenses scandal is defending his recent promotion.

canada.title: Nova Scotia Power appoints new president and CEO after announced departure of current head
canada.summary: Chris Smith, Nova Scotia Power's current executive vice-president, will take over the helm next week from Vivek Sood, who is departing at the end of his one-year contract.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News, Halifax Examiner

canada.title: Pedestrian struck and killed crossing Vancouver street: police
canada.summary: A 45-year-old woman has died after being hit by a vehicle in Vancouver just after midnight on Sunday, according to police. VPD is urging people to be extra cautious as dark, rainy weather lowers visibility.

canada.title: Premier-designate Doerkson was appointed — not elected — interim leader of the party. What happens next?
canada.summary: The Conservative Party of B.C. has said it would have to "pursue the appropriate means" under the party's constitution in order for leader, and now premier-designate, Lorne Doerkson to keep the top job after the provincial election — but it's unclear if that's happened.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News, The Tyee
